final_text:
Survey completed on the simulator stage; the coordinates below are **simulator coordinates**, not millimetres. No camera or image survey was used. Each listed x/y position was read back after arrival.

| Serpentine visit | Confirmed x | Confirmed y | Result |
|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | -1 | -1 | Confirmed |
| 2 | 0 | -1 | Confirmed |
| 3 | 1 | -1 | Confirmed |
| 4 | 1 | 0 | Confirmed |
| 5 | 0 | 0 | Confirmed (centre) |
| 6 | -1 | 0 | Confirmed |
| 7 | -1 | 1 | Confirmed |
| 8 | 0 | 1 | Confirmed |
| 9 | 1 | 1 | Confirmed |

At the centre, the z-stack moves were confirmed at **-1, 0, and +1** (starting z was 0); z was then confirmed returned to 0. The x/y grid traversal ended at (1, 1), so I did **not** return to the starting x/y position (0, 0).

**Issues:** One preliminary check was refused because a quantity object was supplied where the stage expected an integer; no movement occurred from that check. The corrected command was allowed and confirmed. All requested grid positions and z moves were confirmed.

**Back where it started?** No. Final confirmed position is **x=1, y=1, z=0**; start was **x=0, y=0, z=0**.
